details.resampling: linear interpolation of each signal on normalized [0,1] time, endpoints included
details.channel_scaling: weighted mean and population standard deviation over train observations and time; constant scale=1
details.temporal_scope: local adjacency plus four coarse ordered temporal pooling bins
details.ensemble_recipe: mean of three member probabilities; not logits or votes
details.selection: only balanced false/true; no validation/test early stopping
details.shuffle_recipe: seed1729 plus stable physical_id hash, one permutation shared by all camera observations of the physical repetition
